title: Hitchhiking Across China: Thumbs Up Season 3 (Part 3/5)
summary: Part Three moves through Xi'an, private rides, a night with the episode-identified punk band Echo Rush, Harry's haircut, a long ride with the private driver Jacob, an unidentified roadside game, crowded local transport and an improvised food sequence. David's opening labor/art-market self-critique remains beside unsupported claims about wages and towns. The crew's no-payment rule and immediate vehicle boarding are preserved without becoming entitlement or guidance. Band hospitality becomes racialized and sexual pressure; the salon becomes a private worker's credential, body and dating speculation; Jacob's translated relationship becomes David's love-versus-road doctrine; and inconsistent bird/vegetable names remain contradictions rather than polished cuisine. The possible Yellow River claim is held separately from the baiji/Yangtze correction. Chinese speech, Echo Rush member spellings, Jacob's alias, destinations, activity at 1049–1094, food species and private identities remain unresolved. Five publisher categories are exact-span evidence only.

source_notes.claim: Xi'an is associated with the Terracotta Warriors.
source_notes.assessment: UNESCO identifies the terracotta warriors as part of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor complex. Preserve David's brief wording without inflating it into route proof.

source_notes.claim: A rare dolphin went extinct in the river David thinks is the Yellow River.
source_notes.assessment: The likely reference is the baiji or Yangtze River dolphin, whose historical range was the Yangtze/Changjiang drainage; IUCN reports no evidence from the comprehensive 2006 survey. The episode's river location remains uncertain, so this is a probable conflation rather than a silent transcript replacement.

source_notes.assessment: VICE supplies exact prefixes for David Choe, Harry Kim, Jacob, generic female speaker and generic male speaker. The female speaker is not automatically Stephanie, and none is acoustic-model output.
